LizCraft · Brand identity & packaging

Eyilade Oridamisi

LizCraft

A little time.
A lot of care.

An identity for the feeling
of something made by hand.

Follow the thread

The starting point

Care is part of the piece.
And everything around it.

The original LizCraft identity has a sculpted “L”, an expressive serif signature and a contour that keeps unfolding. The maker’s thank-you note gave the wider system its direction: every stitch made with care and intention.

This study carries that feeling from the making table to the wardrobe—through thoughtful print, wrapping and the details someone might keep.

Design
Eyilade Oridamisi
Scope
Identity, art direction, campaigns, packaging & print
Context
Portfolio concept development. New garment imagery and mockups are AI-assisted visualisations.

Made, worn, kept.

A feeling,
before a label.

“Every stitch in this piece was made with care and intention.”From the original LizCraft thank-you note

The signature

Confident in blue.
Warm in gold.

The original mark and its letterforms stay intact. Blue carries the identity; gold brings a small note of warmth. Fraunces gives the words their human, slightly unexpected character.

The connecting thread

One contour.
Room to unfold.

A quiet edge on a label. A generous gesture across a wrap. The same original contour changes its presence through scale, crop and density.

Scroll to unfold, or choose the layers yourself.

The campaign

Made by hand.
Worn your way.

Making, wearing and caring each get a different composition. The warmth of the photography and the rhythm of the type connect them.

The first hello

Care begins
before it’s worn.

A personal note, a folded garment, a contour carried across the tissue. The packaging is designed around a small, considered moment of receiving.

Wrapped parcel

A personal note

A thank-you
worth keeping.

The maker’s original message is retained, including its personal voice. The new layout gives it space and lets the contour stay a quiet supporting detail.

The care continues

For the pieces
you love.

All five instructions from the original care artwork are carried into a clear foldout. Practical information becomes part of the identity, rather than an afterthought.

  • Hand wash gently
  • Use mild soap
  • Do not bleach
  • Do not machine wash
  • Do not iron

A small screen, the same feeling

A little closer.
Even at a glance.

The original work

The thread
was already there.

The original bag application and thank-you artwork established the signature and contour. This wider study builds from those same assets and the maker’s message.

A little time.
A lot of care.

Made, worn, kept.
